user.title: SmartHome
user.description: Configure the SmartHome server over MQTT. The server must be running and connected to the same broker as Home Assistant.

error.mqtt_unavailable: The MQTT integration is not set up or not connected to the broker.
error.no_server: The SmartHome server does not answer on this topic (no configuration on <topic>/bridge/config).

init.title: SmartHome
init.description: What do you want to do?

add_device_details.title: Add a device
add_device_details.description: The device is added on the board right away.

data_description.slave: I2C address of the board. ✓ = connected, ✗ = not connected; you can also type the address of a board that is not listed.
data_description.pin: Pin number on the board (for a blind: the up pin).

edit_device_details.title: Edit: {name}
edit_device_details.description: Changing the slave or a pin re-sends the whole configuration to the board - its outputs are reset for a moment.

data_description.slave: I2C address of the board. ✓ = connected, ✗ = not connected; you can also type the address of a board that is not listed.
data_description.pin: Pin number on the board (for a blind: the up pin).

remove_device.title: Remove a device
remove_device.description: The device disappears from Home Assistant and local button functions that controlled it are removed. The board's configuration is sent again (outputs are reset for a moment).

add_sensor.title: Add a sensor or button
add_sensor.description: 1-Wire thermometers are detected automatically and placed in the room "Brak".

data_description.slave: I2C address of the board. ✓ = connected, ✗ = not connected; you can also type the address of a board that is not listed.

edit_sensor_details.title: Edit: {name}
edit_sensor_details.description: Changing the slave or a pin re-sends the whole configuration to the board - its outputs are reset for a moment.

remove_sensor.title: Remove a sensor or button
remove_sensor.description: The sensor disappears from Home Assistant. Removing a button or hygrometer re-sends the board's configuration (outputs are reset for a moment).

click_functions_details.title: Click functions: {name}
click_functions_details.description: Functions run locally on the board (slave {slave}), even when the server is down - so only devices of the same board can be chosen. Blinds: up / down / stop, other devices: toggle. Saving re-sends the board's configuration (outputs are reset for a moment).

rename_room.title: Rename a room
rename_room.description: The Home Assistant area with the same name is renamed as well.

remove_room.title: Remove a room
remove_room.description: Only an empty room can be removed.

restart_slaves.title: Restart all boards
restart_slaves.description: All boards are restarted and their outputs switched off for a moment.

reinit_slave.title: Re-send configuration to a board
reinit_slave.description: The board is reset and receives its whole configuration again.

error.timeout: The SmartHome server did not answer.
error.invalid_slave: The slave address must be a non-negative number.
error.invalid_action: A blind needs up / down / stop, other devices - toggle.

abort.no_server: The SmartHome server does not answer on this topic (no configuration on <topic>/bridge/config).
